title: On Brezis' open problem 2.2
summary: We prove that the global minimizer of the Ginzburg-Landau energy in the disk of radius $R$ with boundary value $ u(x)=\frac{x}{|x|}$ is the degree-one radial solution of the planar Ginzburg--Landau equation. This gives an affirmative answer to Open Problem~2.2 in Brezis' open-problem list. This is achieved by comparing the radial solution $f$ in the disk with the degree-one radial solution $F$ in the whole plane.
